name: chromatic-aberration-wipe
description: A fast slide wipe with RGB channel split on peak frames.

vars.description: The direction the reveal travels; both scenes slide the same way and the wipe edge follows.
Colour family of the incoming scene's gradient.
Multiplies the red/cyan channel split: 0 removes it, 1 is the stock strength, 2 doubles the offset and saturates the flash.
